items.name: Adicet Bio

items.note: Fresh 10 PM verification confirms Phase 1 prula-cel lupus/lupus-nephritis clinical data Monday Sep 28 followed by an 8:00 AM ET webcast. Active ATM capacity and clinical binary risk remain counter-catalysts.
items.explosiveReason: Fresh Phase 1 autoimmune CAR-T data, strong Friday/AH attention and a smaller valuation create genuine binary re-rating potential; clinical failure risk is equally large.

items.note: Sep 25 NeuroSigma partnership is verified and Friday volume was exceptional. Entry is penalized for extension and an existing ATM/shelf financing overhang.

items.name: Game Your Game
items.status: EXTREME AH MOMENTUM / MAJOR SUPPLY RISK
items.trigger: $1.68 Friday/AH session-high reference; only a controlled hold/retest or fresh volume-backed break
items.note: Friday after-hours move was about +100% on ~41M shares and ~72x relative volume. Major counter-catalyst: resale registrations cover up to 22.2M convertible-preferred-linked shares plus a separate 16.1M-share resale registration. Halt/whipsaw/pump-like behavior risk is high; do not chase.
items.explosiveReason: ~$10M market cap and ~41M AH shares after a +100% AH move create enormous squeeze/price-discovery potential; 22.2M-share resale overhang makes this exceptionally dangerous.

items.name: INLIF Limited
items.trigger: $6.85-$6.87 Friday high zone; require clean break/hold
items.note: Fresh SEC review found a material supply-positive item missed in earlier scoring: INLIF terminated its prior ATM sales agreement that had allowed up to $100M of stock sales. Friday momentum was extreme, but extension and shelf-registration risk keep Entry constrained.
items.explosiveReason: Extreme Friday rotation plus termination of a prior $100M ATM can improve supply dynamics; extension and other shelf/supply risks keep it from scoring even higher.

items.name: Nauticus Robotics
items.note: Sep 25 8-K confirms a non-binding LOI for up to $50M strategic private-placement investment. It is not committed and could materially dilute holders or change control.
items.explosiveReason: Small-cap robotics narrative plus a proposed investment up to $50M can attract speculative flows, but the LOI is non-binding and potential dilution is substantial.

items.name: Greenland Energy
items.status: THEME / CORPORATE-CATALYST WATCH WITH SUPPLY RISK
items.trigger: $6.67 Friday high; alternatively controlled higher-low reclaim
items.invalidation: $4.83 Friday low / loss of momentum structure
items.note: Critical-minerals/Greenland theme remains active and the Jameson Land farm-out extension is recent. Sep 23 SEC filing includes a securities purchase agreement and pre-funded warrant, increasing supply-risk weighting.
items.explosiveReason: Greenland/critical-minerals theme and prior volatility provide substantial continuation potential if $6.67 clears; theme linkage and warrant/pre-funded supply are risks.

items.name: Hyperscale Data
items.note: Initial 20 MW AI-compute customer agreement and $55M Ault investment remain real catalysts; Friday volume was enormous. Convertible preferred financing and controlling-holder structure remain major risk factors.
items.explosiveReason: AI data-center theme, heavy volume and financing headline can support a sharp move, but convertible/preferred structure limits clean asymmetry.

items.name: Mint Incorporation
items.note: Friday after-hours continuation was strong, but no comparably fresh material catalyst was verified. August financing included 1.4M shares plus pre-funded warrants for 1.1M shares, following a July PIPE, so supply risk is meaningful.
items.explosiveReason: Sub-$1 price, strong AH momentum and small capitalization create large percentage-move potential, offset by weak fresh catalyst quality and recent financing supply.

items.name: ClearOne
items.trigger: $5.10 AH high reference; no chase without base/retest
items.note: Friday AH gained ~43% on ~1M shares with sub-1M reported float, but no strong fresh operating catalyst was verified. A September preliminary offering contemplates 2.86M-4.29M units at $3.50 with warrants, a severe supply/dilution counterweight.
items.explosiveReason: Very small reported float plus +43% AH move can produce violent percentage swings, but weak catalyst quality and a potentially huge unit/warrant offering make this low-quality explosiveness.
